summary_for_children: Al-Insan means Man. It praises people who feed the needy, orphans and captives only for Allah, wanting no thanks.
environment_concept: A home where food is given to the needy, the orphan and the captive, asking nothing in return; the promised reward is only read, not shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A kitchen and doorway, baskets of food.

areas.name: The Doorway
areas.description: A doorway where food is shared.

activities.name: Share the meal
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Reward is described only in ayahs.

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
